proposed_capability: All household Sims prefer verified NanoCan disposal of dirty empty dishes instead of autonomous sink washing; design cursor-free EA-native item disposal/reward equivalence with provenance and zero desktop input. Separate player drag-and-drop household-scale payout from in-game Sim disposal reward and measure actual funds delta independently.
player_save_control_impact: Read-only, opt-in household native policy with bounded fresh dish/NanoCan observations; no mouse, keyboard, screen takeover, unverified EA APIs, game assets, save edit, Build/Buy purchasing, or forced sink queue cancellation. Player activity, reservations and goal ownership outrank proposals.
expected_outcome: A pure policy seam can propose disposal for one uniquely identified empty dirty dish to a verified available NanoCan, prefer cursor-free drag-equivalent route only with exact game-native proof, expose ordinary Sim disposal as separate payout class and protected fallback, suppress sink only as an advisory when safe NanoCan action is verified; both branches require independent before/after funds and object outcome evidence; no mechanical effects without exact EA hook.
negative_tests: No assumption that autonomous Sim throwing out a plate returns drag-and-drop household-scaled payout
No invented currency or fake reward posting
No moving edible or player-reserved food/dishes
No disposal without observed installed NanoCan, active home lot, current capture and native affordance
No duplicates for pending attempts or batch/stack counted as a single disposal
No sink suppression when native NanoCan route unsupported
No cooldown bypass, per-frame scans or automatic purchases
No queue interference during player commands or urgent Sims needs
No mouse/keyboard/OS controls even as fallback
No game effect claim from passing offline tests
No synthetic EA interaction/TGI identifiers without source
rollback_path: Revert dedicated policy PR; no game or save files are touched.
unresolved_unknowns: Exact patch EA object and interaction tuning IDs for NanoCan and drag-drop reward path
Whether any native script route is actually equivalent to player drag for per-member payout
Whether sink autonomy XML can be narrowly and safely retuned on selected installed patch
P08 disposable-game A/B test and rollback on local host; BI-002 hunger remains separate active
